blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The first passenger train in India ran between Mumbai (Bori Bunder) and Thane on 16 April 1853.
Indian Railways was nationalised in 1951 and is organized into 17 administrative zones.
Bholu the guard elephant, holding a lamp, serves as the official mascot of Indian Railways.
Project Unigauge aims to convert all narrow and meter gauge tracks into broad gauge across India.
